decisions.reason: As a low-cost, service-based extension of the firm’s existing support offer, the training programme preserves customer relationships and option value with limited downside, so it is worth keeping.
The fourth rotary axis accessory fits the firm’s modular machine base and is relatively inexpensive to leave available, so management would likely keep this complementary option open.

Because hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm’s core offer and likely requires specialized support while early market evidence appears limited, real-options logic points to abandoning it.
A high-speed CNC milling machine line is close to the firm’s core capabilities and strategic direction, and a multi-model platform justifies continued commitment despite remaining uncertainty.
The automatic tool change system builds directly on the installed product base, supports customer productivity, and can be kept on the market at relatively low incremental cost.
